title: Ubizo Olungalalelwanga Ezweni Lokuzikhukhumeza
intro: Umi emanxiweni empucuko eyayikade inkulu, lapho amandla nokuziqhenya kwakungenamingcele. Isithunywa sasihamba phakathi kwabo, sibiza iqiniso, kodwa izinhliziyo zabo zazilukhuni. Isixwayiso asizange silalelwe, futhi isibhakabhaka ngokwaso saba ithuluzi lolaka. Wayengubani lesi sithunywa, futhi kwenzekani ngalabo abenqaba ubizo?
clues: Ngathunyelwa kubantu ababenamandla angenakuqhathaniswa futhi abakha isikhumbuzo kuzo zonke izindawo eziphakemeyo.
Abantu bami babezibona bengenakunqotshwa futhi bathi, 'Ngubani onamandla kunathi?'
Ngababiza ukuba bakhonze u-Allah kuphela, kodwa bangisola ngobuwula nokuqamba amanga.
Bangiphonsela inselelo yokuthi ngilethe isijeziso engangisithembisile uma ngikhuluma iqiniso.
U-Allah wathumela phezu kwabo umoya ongenalutho ongashiyi lutho owafika phezu kwabo.
Mina nalabo abakholwa kanye nami sasindiswa ngesihe sika-Allah, kanti abangakholwa babhujiswa ngokuphelele.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: UHud kanye namakholwa basindiswa, kwathi abangakholwa babhujiswa
UHud washiya abantu bakhe ngaphambi kwanoma yisiphi isijeziso
outcome.answer: UHud kanye namakholwa basindiswa, kwathi abangakholwa babhujiswa

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
